findings.W3: fixed: a wait, an operation inspect or the session read before entry that answers an error the daemon may get past (connection failure, retry, cancelled, internal, failed) keeps the intent to enter and is sent again on the next tick. A Create whose wait answered retry/deadline showed 'The daemon took too long to answer; try again.' (after-0042) and was entered at the next tick (after-0045); before, the page stayed with the error and nothing more was read (before-0034). An O inspect answering retry/deadline showed the error under the listed facts (after2-0014) and was read again (after2-0016). Help opened during the follow or after its error keeps it: the Create was entered at the first tick after Back (after4-0010, after4-0016; after the error, after4-0026, after4-0028, after4-0040); before, Help during a Create's wait left the page at 'completed / complete' with no entry two ticks later (before3-0011). An error such as not_found is not read again, for a running operation too (by component test: the tick no longer starts a wait for every running operation)
